verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents in-app automated bank reconciliation workflows and accountant access for review. Its API lets an agent read expenses, payments and reports and post adjustment journal entries, so a custom agent could assemble pieces of a month-end close. However, nothing shows bank-transaction or reconciliation endpoints, agent-driven matching, or exception flagging, and there is no agent-facing tooling (llms.txt and markdown docs both return 404). Missing for 10: API access to bank feeds and reconciliation matching, exception-flagging capability, an agent-orchestrated close workflow, a review/approval handoff mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.
